name: dragon the descent module under its main parachutes
note: Crew spacecraft render model (tools/make_crew_models.py), the descent module under its main parachutes. Crew Dragon in orbit: the trunk (cells on half of it, four fins), the capsule, the docking ring; the nose cone hinged open forward. Body frame: +Z out of the docking port, origin at the port's contact point.

sources.subject: attitude
sources.value: the sim hands in a full attitude (approach, docked, entry); this law is only its fallback
diameters and lengths rounded from the references; shapes estimated from photographs
sources.source: SpaceX Dragon page: 8.1 m tall with trunk, 4 m across; trunk 3.7 m with body-mounted solar cells on half its circumference; the nose cone hinges open to expose the docking adapter (IDSS) | Wikipedia 'SpaceX Dragon 2': four main parachutes, ~35 m across

sources.value: white: white paint (operator liveries in launch photographs); black: black paint / carbon composite (interstages, legs); grey: grey paint (Soyuz, Long March detail); chute_red: red parachute nylon (Shenzhou, Dragon canopies)
sources.source: Liveries from photographs; reflectance from the presets.
